email.subject: Smile Works' site may be losing patients on mobile
email.body:
Hi Maria,

I took a quick look at Smile Works Dentistry's website. Two things stood out: it isn't mobile-friendly, and there's no tap-to-call number. Most people searching for a dentist nearby do it on their phone, often when they're already in pain and want to call right away — if the site is hard to use and there's no quick way to dial you, they just call the next practice on the list.

I also noticed no patient reviews are shown and the footer looks outdated, which can make visitors second-guess the practice.

I fix these kinds of issues for a flat fee. Happy to do a free 10-minute walkthrough and show you exactly what I'd change.

Worth a quick call?

Alex
Northlight Web
